status: Prospectively registered before new conditional-state proof, mappings, ordinary traffic or model calls.

event_discrimination.ordinary_union: Union hits>0 over registered ordinary traces, preserving each raw identity; all target members must remain zero in that baseline. This selection union is not replacement of per-run raw counts.
event_discrimination.positive: Spec-checker-clean multistep event completed within 384 new physical cycles, each mapped source member actually executed.
causal_controls: Prefix before the registered prerequisite/resolution leaves target sources unhit.
Same-budget control removing the prerequisite or resolution does not hit those source targets.
Separate event families cannot be counted from the same shared stall/reset/ready group.
event_discrimination.claims: Finite ordinary/control non-hits are evidence for the screening gate, not universal unreachability. Formal claims require separately proved assumptions. Plain mode selection is not a multistep target.

semantics.engine: typed full activation guards; independent Yosys definitions, bounded egg and Z3; source mapping and edge/reset context retained
semantics.values: Two-state; only independently inductively proved, hash-bound state-domain lemmas may restrict subsequent queries. No assumed/unproven invariants.
semantics.unsupported: Explicitly unresolved; no unsupported mapping admitted, no removal from raw denominator
semantics.clock: single posedge with original synchronous reset; do not merge contexts

roles.checker_author: Claude specification-only; no RTL/private calibrated traces/B-C outcomes
roles.reviewer: Fresh Claude read-only, may inspect implementation solely for attribution
roles.driver_and_calibration: GPT/Codex, fixed public-port JSON driver; no checker expected-output edits
roles.experimental_stimulus: gpt-6.1-sol JSON only after offline freeze; no solver/handwritten target witnesses
roles.measurement: Fixed simulator counters/hash/schema; no model edits

stop_rules: Static failures are retained; do not buy checker/model calls for an unqualified scope.
One three-repetition B development per frozen qualifying scope; no selective replacement or budget tightening.
C only after the unchanged B gate; fresh matched formal B, A/C and own-trajectory token-matched placebo require separate final freeze.
prior_result: wbxbar old scope blocked by unsafe free m_stall due unproved index range; old scope/results remain immutable. No C results used.
independence: Same fixed wbxbar design/config as prior screen; new conditional proof scope, not an independent IP.

event_families: contended slave ownership held by outstanding responses then drain and transfer to waiting master
nonresponding slave times out and aborts then new cycle to same slave succeeds
master aborts outstanding pipelined cycle and a subsequent owner acquires resource without stale response
candidates.ordinary_policy: Ordinary isolated reads/writes from each master to each mapped slave and unmapped address; direct mapped ranges 0x00-0x0f/0x10-0x1f. Concurrent accesses to different slaves, one-master prompt pipelined bursts 1/2/4/7 and alternating destinations only after replies. Prompt in-order ACK/ERR, no engineered stall/timeouts or competing ownership; byte masks vary. Include normal release/reacquire. Aborted work is separate targeted event, not ordinary.
candidates.proof_boundary: Original parent and real original children; no DUT rewrite, replica counters, protocol stubs, source-derived golden model or state-reachability assumptions.
candidates.public_contract_addendum: Public module/interface comments are separate cited intent; checker author must not receive executable RTL or formal implementation-specific properties.

conditional_proof.primary: For each master N=0,1: mgrant[N] implies unsigned mindex[N] <= NS (2). Actual request index site activation additionally includes !grant[N][NS], and final m_stall excludes o_merr[N]. Prove the stronger mgrant-only property first.
conditional_proof.environment: Original RTL initial assignments; all unspecified registers arbitrary. Reset synchronous active-high. Start with NO master/slave protocol assumptions and no fixed inputs. If initial reset needed, separately label first two edges reset-high and do not generalize pre-reset. Do not initialize mindex to zero.
conditional_proof.proof_engines: Yosys original transition system with SMTBMC/Z3 base and induction; bounded proof alone not accepted. Alternative SAT temporal induction allowed with explicit evidence.
negative_controls: Unconditional index range should not be presumed: retain witness with uninitialized mindex=3 and mgrant=0 if possible.
A false active-index assertion (e.g. mgrant implies index==0) must produce counterexample.
Nonvacuity: each master can reach active index 0,1,2; preserve witnesses privately.
conditional_proof.binding: Proof source/config/observer/engine outputs hashed. Proof-only observers do not alter DUT sources. Import only proved lemmas, not cover witnesses. Out-of-range select stays arbitrary outside its valid domain; test wrong bound, missing lemma, and tampered hashes fail closed.
conditional_proof.coverage: Simulation uses original SV only. No added observer/replica source counters; original denominator retained.
